notes.title: Various specification changes
notes.notes:
・The ghosts will not attack until the berserkness value is exceeded.
・The color of the orb changes when the ghost goes berserk.
・The screen shaking when they attack has been reduced.
・The blue-haired ghosts that always go berserk will now have their photo ranks always increased.
・The rank of the photo will be increased by 1 or 2 depending on the size of the map.
・Fixed a problem with ghosts going out of range of the map.
・Changed so that the distance is not determined when the ghost is on a different floor.
・Increased the amount of time ghosts can stay in one place, depending on the size of the map.
